summary_taigi: 「萬象品茗」隨Nancy踅萬華的茶室，對老歌佮茶香，認識茶室女性的生活。導覽用國台語混合，戲劇閣有部分英語互動。
description_taigi:
「萬象品茗」隨Nancy踅萬華的茶室，對老歌佮茶香，認識茶室女性的生活。導覽用國台語混合，戲劇閣有部分英語互動。

Nancy為著探望生病的阿公轉來萬華，循金孔雀、艋舺茶館佮牽手茶室，遇著國小同學阿珠佮美滿，慢慢了解茶室女性為家庭打拚、陪伴老客人的故事。

臺北市政府文化局主辦，閱野文創執行。愛佇開始前10分鐘到捷運龍山寺站集合、領導覽設備；活動會踅街路佮進茶室，建議穿好行的鞋仔。報名愛填真實姓名、身分證字號佮出生日，辦理保險。一般票250元，65歲以上佮1歲以下150元，親子套票300元，含1位大人佮1位12歲以下囡仔。退票照ACCUPASS規定，當日遲到抑是無到無退票；若天災延期，請看主辦通知。

evidence.quote:
本場主題：萬象品茗；國台語混合、部分英文。

萬華萬象—共生與綻放「茶室文化主題走動式戲劇導覽」 Wanhua in Many Colors: Coexisting & Flourishing — A Teahouse Culture Immersive Walking Theater Experience 推開茶室木門，走進被時光凝結的常民生活現場。這不僅是一場走讀導覽，更是一段融合角色演繹、感官互動與真實場域的文化體驗。邀您化身故事中的旅人，親身走進老城客廳，讀懂屬於萬華的生命記憶與溫暖日常。 Open the door to an old teahouse and step into everyday life from another time. This is more than a walking tour. It’s a cultural experience that brings together live performances, sensory experiences, and real places in Wanhua. Join us as a traveler in the story, step into Wanhua’s “living room,” and discover the memories, stories, and everyday warmth of this old neighborhood. 🌿 主題一｜《青草綻放》（臺灣台語場） 自幼赴美的 Nancy，為了替住院的阿公祈福，重新踏上了這趟萬華歸鄉旅途。在導覽員的帶領下，觀眾將與 Nancy 一同從百年青草巷啟程，品飲青草茶、辨識草藥。隨後步入剝皮寮的紅磚木窗下，尋找昔日「老茶桌仔」遺留的歷史線索。在這趟充滿草藥清涼與歷史氣息的五感走讀中，Nancy 究竟會遇見誰？這趟尋根之旅，又將如何揭開萬華強韌的生活美學與在地真切的人情溫度？邀請您親自走入街區，一探究竟。 (青草綻放場次補充說明：兩場活動戲劇演出與導覽皆相同，演出以在地生活最真實的「國台語混合」自然呈現，不懂深奧台語也能輕鬆融入，非常適合長輩或闔家同行！) 🍵 主題二｜《萬象品茗》（中英雙語場） 自幼赴美的 Nancy 為了探望生病的阿公重返萬華，邀請觀眾化身「茶友」，循著阿公常去的「金孔雀」、「艋舺茶館」與「牽手茶室」展開尋味之旅。旅途中 Nancy 意外重逢國小同學阿珠與美滿，在熟悉的老歌與茶香中，看見茶室女性為家計打拚的辛酸，也體會她們用溫暖陪伴老客人的真情—原來阿公念念不忘的不只是茶，更是「茶燒燒，心嘛燒燒」的老城人情味。 (萬象品茗場次補充說明：兩場活動戲劇演出與導覽皆相同，劇中穿插「國台語與部分英文日常互動」，導覽則以「國台語混合」解說。10/4 中英文雙語場次特別為外國友人備有「英文戲劇導覽小卡」，無論是外國朋友或是想要帶外國友人體驗在地文化的民眾，都能瞭解萬華茶室文化！) 票務與參與資訊 活動地點：萬華區街區與在地茶室 集合地點：捷運龍山寺站 活動場次：  【主題一｜青草綻放】 10/03 (六) 10:30-12:00(臺灣台語場) 10/17 (六) 10:30-12:00 【主題二｜萬象品茗】 10/04 (日) 10:30-12:00 (中英雙語場) 10/18 (日) 10:30-12:00 票價資訊： 一般票：NT$ 250/人 愛心票：NT$ 150/人(65歲以上長者、1歲以下兒童) 親子套票：NT$ 300/組(1位成人及1位12歲以下兒童) 報名與活動注意事項 實名制與保險：為保障參與者權益，本活動全程投保公共意外責任險。購票報名時，請務必確實填寫參加者之真實中文姓名、身分證字號與出生年月日。 準時報到：請於活動開始前 10 分鐘抵達集合地點，領取導覽設備與聆聽行前說明，以利準時出發。 穿著與設備：活動全程需於街區步道與室內空間步行，建議穿著輕便衣物與好走的鞋子。 觀賞禮儀：演出過程中包含演員實境互動，請配合現場引路人引導；為維持整體氛圍，進行中請避免大聲喧嘩。 意見回饋：活動尾聲將安排短暫交流，懇請參與者協助填寫回饋問卷，共同為萬華文化推廣提供寶貴建言。 退票規範：本活動依照 ACCUPASS 平台退改政策辦理。活動當日因個人因素逾時未到或缺席者，恕不予退費。 如遇天然災害以致活動延期，本活動將「青草綻放」場次延期至10月24日舉辦；「萬象品茗」場次延期至10月25日舉辦。   Program Introduction & Storylines 🌿 Theme 1｜"Herbal Blooms" (Taiwanese Hokkien Session) Nancy grew up in the United States. Now, she returns to Wanhua to pray for her grandfather, who is in the hospital. Led by a local guide, you’ll join Nancy on a journey through the century-old Herb Lane. Along the way, you’ll taste herbal tea and learn about local medicinal plants. Then, you’ll walk through Bopiliao Historic Block, passing its red-brick walls and wooden windows as you search for clues left behind by the old tea stalls. Along this journey filled with the fresh scent of herbs and the atmosphere of old Wanhua, who will Nancy meet? And what will she discover about the resilience, everyday beauty, and human warmth of Wanhua? Come walk the streets with us and find out for yourself.  🍵 Theme 2｜"Tea & Stories of Wanhua" (Mandarin & English Bilingual Session) Nancy grew up in the United States and returns to Wanhua to visit her sick grandfather. Join Nancy as a “tea companion” and follow the places her grandfather used to visit, including Golden Peacock, Bangka Teahouse, and Hand-in-Hand Teahouse. Along the way, Nancy unexpectedly reunites with her old elementary school classmates, Ah Zhu and Mei Man. As old songs play and the aroma of tea fills the air, she learns about the struggles these teahouse women faced while supporting their families, as well as the warmth and companionship they shared with their longtime customers. Nancy begins to understand that what her grandfather missed was not just the tea, but the warmth of the people and the sense of community that made old Wanhua special. Event Info Locations: Wanhua historic neighborhood streets & local authentic teahouses Meeting Point: MRT Longshan Temple Station Session Schedule: 【Theme 1｜Herbal Blooms】 10/03 (Sat) 10:30–12:00 (Taiwanese Hokkien Session) 10/17 (Sat) 10:30–12:00 (Herbal Blooms Note: Both sessions are exactly the same. The play and tour are in a natural mix of Mandarin and Taiwanese, just like real daily life here. You don’t need to know advanced Taiwanese to enjoy it—it's great for seniors and the whole family!) 【Theme 2｜Tea & Stories of Wanhua】 10/04 (Sun) 10:30–12:00 (Mandarin & English Bilingual Session) 10/18 (Sun) 10:30–12:00 (Tea & Stories of Wanhua Note: Both sessions are exactly the same. The actors chat naturally in a mix of Mandarin, Taiwanese, and some everyday English, while the tour itself is in Mandarin and Taiwanese. For the Oct 4 bilingual session, we have a handy English Guide Card ready for foreign guests. Whether you're visiting from abroad or bringing friends from overseas, everyone can easily follow along and enjoy Wanhua’s teahouse culture!)    Ticket Prices: General Ticket: NT$ 250 / person Concession Ticket: NT$ 150 / person (seniors aged 65 and above and infants under 1 year old) Family Package: NT$ 300 / set (1 adult + 1 child under 12) Registration & Insurance Insurance & Registration: Public liability insurance is included for all participants. When signing up, please make sure to provide each attendee’s full legal name, ID/Passport number, and date of birth. Arrival Time: Please arrive at the meeting spot at least 10 minutes early to pick up your audio gear and listen to a brief orientation so we can head out on time. What to Wear: We’ll be walking through outdoor alleys and visiting indoor teahouses. We strongly recommend wearing comfortable clothes and walking shoes. Tour Etiquette: This experience includes live, interactive performances. Please follow your guide's directions and keep noise to a minimum so everyone can enjoy the immersive atmosphere. Feedback: We’ll have a brief wrap-up chat at the end. We’d love it if you could take a couple of minutes to fill out our quick survey and help us keep sharing Wanhua's culture! Refund Policy: Ticket changes and refunds follow ACCUPASS policies. Unfortunately, no refunds can be given for late arrivals or no-shows on the event day. Rescheduling Due to Severe Weather: If the event has to be postponed due to severe weather (such as a typhoon warning), Herbal Blooms will be rescheduled to October 24, and Tea & Stories of Wanhua will be rescheduled to October 25.   主辦單位：臺北市政府文化局 執行單位：閱野文創股份有限公司

Join us as a traveler in the story, step into Wanhua’s “living room,” and discover the memories, stories, and everyday warmth of this old neighborhood. 🌿 主題一｜《青草綻放》（臺灣台語場） 自幼赴美的 Nancy，為了替住院的阿公祈福，重新踏上了這趟萬華歸鄉旅途。在導覽員的帶領下，觀眾將與 Nancy 一同從百年青草巷啟程，品飲青草茶、辨識草藥。隨後步入剝皮寮的紅磚木窗下，尋找昔日「老茶桌仔」遺留的歷史線索。在這趟充滿草藥清涼與歷史氣息的五感走讀中，Nancy 究竟會遇見誰？這趟尋根之旅，又將如何揭開萬華強韌的生活美學與在地真切的人情溫度？邀請您親自走入街區，一探究竟。 (青草綻放場次補充說明：兩場活動戲劇演出與導覽皆相同，演出以在地生活最真實的「國台語混合」自然呈現，不懂深奧台語也能輕鬆融入，非常適合長輩或闔家同行！) 🍵 主題二｜《萬象品茗》（中英雙語場） 自幼赴美的 Nancy 為了探望生病的阿公重返萬華，邀請觀眾化身「茶友」，循著阿公常去的「金孔雀」、「艋舺茶館」與「牽手茶室」展開尋味之旅。旅途中 Nancy 意外重逢國小同學阿珠與美滿，在熟悉的老歌與茶香中，看見茶室女性為家計打拚的辛酸，也體會她們用溫暖陪伴老客人的真情—原來阿公念念不忘的不只是茶，更是「茶燒燒，心嘛燒燒」的老城人情味。 (萬象品茗場次補充說明：兩場活動戲劇演出與導覽皆相同，劇中穿插「國台語與部分英文日常互動」，導覽則以「國台語混合」解說。10/4 中英文雙語場次特別為外國友人備有「英文戲劇導覽小卡」，無論是外國朋友或是想要帶外國友人體驗在地文化的民眾，都能瞭解萬華茶室文化！) 票務與參與資訊 活動地點：萬華區街區與在地茶室 集合地點：捷運龍山寺站 活動場次：  【主題一｜青草綻放】 10/03 (六) 10:30-12:00(臺灣台語場) 10/17 (六) 10:30-12:00 【主題二｜萬象品茗】 10/04 (日) 10:30-12:00 (中英雙語場) 10/18 (日) 10:30-12:00 票價資訊： 一般票：NT$ 250/人 愛心票：NT$ 150/人(65歲以上長者、1歲以下兒童) 親子套票：NT$ 300/組(1位成人及1位12歲以下兒童) 報名與活動注意事項 實名制與保險：為保障參與者權益，本活動全程投保公共意外責任險。購票報名時，請務必確實填寫參加者之真實中文姓名、身分證字號與出生年月日。 準時報到：請於活動開始前 10 分鐘抵達集合地點，領取導覽設備與聆聽行前說明，以利準時出發。 穿著與設備：活動全程需於街區步道與室內空間步行，建議穿著輕便衣物與好走的鞋子。 觀賞禮儀：演出過程中包含演員實境互動，請配合現場引路人引導；為維持整體氛圍，進行中請避免大聲喧嘩。 意見回饋：活動尾聲將安排短暫交流，懇請參與者協助填寫回饋問卷，共同為萬華文化推廣提供寶貴建言。 退票規範：本活動依照 ACCUPASS 平台退改政策辦理。活動當日因個人因素逾時未到或缺席者，恕不予退費。 如遇天然災害以致活動延期，本活動將「青草綻放」場次延期至10月24日舉辦；「萬象品茗」場次延期至10月25日舉辦。   Program Introduction & Storylines 🌿 Theme 1｜"Herbal Blooms" (Taiwanese Hokkien Session) Nancy grew up in the United States. Now, she returns to Wanhua to pray for her grandfather, who is in the hospital. Led by a local guide, you’ll join Nancy on a journey through the century-old Herb Lane. Along the way, you’ll taste herbal tea and learn about local medicinal plants. Then, you’ll walk through Bopiliao Historic Block, passing its red-brick walls and wooden windows as you search for clues left behind by the old tea stalls. Along this journey filled with the fresh scent of herbs and the atmosphere of old Wanhua, who will Nancy meet? And what will she discover about the resilience, everyday beauty, and human warmth of Wanhua? Come walk the streets with us and find out for yourself.  🍵 Theme 2｜"Tea & Stories of Wanhua" (Mandarin & English Bilingual Session) Nancy grew up in the United States and returns to Wanhua to visit her sick grandfather. Join Nancy as a “tea companion” and follow the places her grandfather used to visit, including Golden Peacock, Bangka Teahouse, and Hand-in-Hand Teahouse. Along the way, Nancy unexpectedly reunites with her old elementary school classmates, Ah Zhu and Mei Man. As old songs play and the aroma of tea fills the air, she learns about the struggles these teahouse women faced while supporting their families, as well as the warmth and companionship they shared with their longtime customers. Nancy begins to understand that what her grandfather missed was not just the tea, but the warmth of the people and the sense of community that made old Wanhua special.
